entries.definition: a false reason woven in front of an action; pre- means before
entries.definitionCN: 借口；托辞；pre- 表「在前」，把假理由「织」在行动之前

entries.definition: a section of writing; shorter than a text and without the idea of the whole work
entries.definitionCN: 段落；指作品中的一部分，不指整部著作

entries.definition: sacred writing; text once meant almost exactly this in English
entries.definitionCN: 经文；text 早期的含义几乎就是它

entries.definition: the exact choice of words; narrower than text, which names the whole written body
entries.definitionCN: 措辞；比 text 窄，text 指整篇书面文字

normalIntro.en: Real links: the weaving root texere, the family of texture and context, the sermon text, and the modern text message.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：编织词根 texere、texture 与 context 词族、布道经文、以及现代短信。

normal.en: Text comes from weaving: words woven line by line like thread.
normal.cn: text 来自编织：文字像线一样一行行织出。

normal.en: Texture is what weaving feels like; context is what is woven with it.
normal.cn: texture 是织物的手感；context 是与它织在一起的东西。

normal.en: A preacher once spoke from a chosen text; now a teenager speaks by texting.
normal.cn: 牧师曾依选定的经文讲道；如今少年靠发短信说话。

normal.en: Pretext: a reason woven in front to cover the real one.
normal.cn: pretext：织在前面的理由，盖住真理由。

normal.en: Textbook: the book that holds the set texts for study.
normal.cn: textbook：装着指定课文的教材。

abstract.en: Every text is cloth: threads of words, woven tight enough to carry meaning.
abstract.cn: 每篇文本都是布：文字作线，织得够紧才承得住意义。

abstract.en: Cut a sentence from its context and the weave frays.
abstract.cn: 把句子从语境中剪出来，布就散线。

abstract.en: A text message is a woven ribbon only ten centimetres long.
abstract.cn: 短信只是一条十厘米长的织带。

examples.en: The printed text differs slightly from the manuscript.
examples.cn: 印本正文与手稿略有出入。

examples.en: She texted her mother as soon as the plane landed.
examples.cn: 飞机一落地她就给妈妈发了短信。

examples.en: Scholars still argue about the original text of the play.
examples.cn: 学者们仍在争论这部剧本的原文。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贴克斯特」——把课文一段段贴在课桌上克敌制胜，先贴先读 → text 文本、课文

root: 拉丁语 texere「编织」→ textus「织成之物、话语织体」→ 古法语 texte → 英语；同根词 texture、context、pretext。

sensesIntro.en: Text starts as the woven body of words against its trimmings, becomes an object of study, shrinks into a phone message, turns into a verb, and can still name the single passage a sermon is built on.
sensesIntro.cn: text 从与装饰相对的「文字织体」出发，成为研究对象，缩成手机短信，转为动词，也仍可指布道所依的单一经段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: words woven line by line into cloth.
core.cn: 核心意象：文字如线，一行行织成布。

branches.en: The main cloth of words against pictures and notes.
branches.cn: 相对于图片与注释的文字主布。

branches.en: The fixed cloth becomes an object to study and compare.
branches.cn: 写定的织体成为可研究比较的对象。

branches.en: The message shrinks the cloth to a ribbon, then names the sending.
branches.cn: 短信把布缩成细带，进而命名发送动作。

branches.en: One thread cut out becomes the base of a sermon.
branches.cn: 剪出的一根线成为布道的底本。

branches.en: Weaving and studying share the same cloth.
branches.cn: 编织与研究共享同一块布。

intro.en: The weaving root texere/tec- builds a wide family: text, texture, context, pretext, textile, and even technology through Greek craft-words.
intro.cn: 编织词根 texere/tec- 构建了庞大词族：text、texture、context、pretext、textile，甚至经希腊工匠词进入 technology。

latinIntro.en: Latin texere and textus sit under the whole family; the root also gave textor, a weaver, and textura, the structure of weaving.
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族建立在拉丁 texere 与 textus 之上；词根还给出 textor「织工」与 textura「织构」。

definition_zh: 旗；旗帜；标记；使疲软；降低
definition_en: a piece of cloth with a special design used as a symbol or signal; also, to mark something, or to become weak
core_image: 旗杆顶上迎风展开、招摇示意的一块布
scene: 运动场上，风把那块印着星星条纹的布吹得猎猎作响，全体起立注视。 The national flag rose slowly up the pole.
sceneCN: 这里 flag 是「国旗；旗帜」（第 1 个义项：用作象征或信号的特制布块）；句意为国旗沿旗杆缓缓升起。

senses.title: A cloth symbol or signal
senses.definition: a piece of cloth with a special design, used as a national symbol or a signal
senses.definitionCN: 带有特殊图案、用作国家象征或信号的布块
senses.example: Every country has its own flag.
senses.exampleCN: 每个国家都有自己的国旗。
senses.why: The core image is a cloth raised high so people far away can read its message.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是把布举到高处，让远处的人读懂它传递的信息。

senses.title: A marker used to show a place
senses.definition: a small marker, often on a map or in the ground, showing a spot
senses.definitionCN: 常出现在地图或地面上、用来标出位置的小标记
senses.example: The map puts a flag on the school.
senses.exampleCN: 地图上给学校标了旗。
senses.why: A flag marks a spot just as a national flag signals a country, so the sign spread to small markers.
senses.whyCN: 旗 signaling 国家，小旗 signaling 位置，标志义随之铺开。

senses.title: To mark something for attention
senses.definition: to mark a thing or a problem so people notice it
senses.definitionCN: 标记某物或某问题以引起注意
senses.example: Teachers flagged the errors in red.
senses.exampleCN: 老师用红笔标出错误。
senses.why: Raising a flag draws every eye, so to flag became to draw attention.
senses.whyCN: 升旗会吸引所有目光，flag 于是变成「提醒注意」。

senses.title: To become weak or tired
senses.definition: to become less strong, active, or eager
senses.definitionCN: 变得不如从前有力、活跃或热切
senses.example: His interest in chess flagged.
senses.exampleCN: 他对国际象棋的兴趣减退了。
senses.why: A loose flag hangs limp in no wind; the drooping cloth gave English this sense of fading strength.
senses.whyCN: 无风时旗布软垂，这幅下坠的画面给了英语「力量衰退」的含义。

intro.en: Flag has two old streams in English: one for the waving cloth, one for drooping weakness.
intro.cn: flag 在英语中有两条古老源流：一条指向飘扬的旗，一条指向低垂的疲软。

items.en: The cloth sense is usually linked to Old Norse flaka, meaning to hang loose like cloth.
items.cn: 布块义一般追溯到古诺斯语 flaka，意为像布那样松松垂挂。

items.en: Middle English flagge named a fluttering cloth, later a banner in the wind.
items.cn: 中古英语 flagge 指飘动的布，后来指风中招展的旗帜。

items.en: The weakness sense came from Old English flacca and other Germanic words meaning to droop.
items.cn: 疲软义来自古英语 flacca 及其他意为下垂的日耳曼词。

items.en: Both streams may share a Germanic root about things that flap or flop loosely.
items.cn: 两条源流可能共用一个表示松软摆动的日耳曼词根。

items.en: Modern English split the senses clearly: flags as symbols and markers, flagging as fading energy.
items.cn: 现代英语把各义分得很清楚：旗与标记属名词，疲软属动词。

note.en: Flag has sound-alikes and close neighbours worth checking.
note.cn: flag 有音近词与近邻词，值得核对。

senses.definitionCN: 质量、水平接近某人某物
senses.example: No other cake can compare with Grandma's.
senses.exampleCN: 没有哪种蛋糕比得上奶奶做的。
senses.why: Once compared, things stand equal or unequal.
senses.whyCN: 一经比较，事物便分出高低对等。

senses.title: To exchange ideas or reports
senses.definition: to share and check ideas or figures with others
senses.definitionCN: 与他人互相对照各自的看法或数据
senses.example: After the test, we compared notes in pairs.
senses.exampleCN: 考完后我们两人一组对笔记。
senses.why: Two sets of notes laid side by side are being compared.
senses.whyCN: 两份笔记并排放在一起，正是在互相比较。

intro.en: Compare is built on Latin words for equal.
intro.cn: compare 建立在拉丁语「对等」的词根之上。

items.en: Latin par meant equal, seen in pair and parity.
items.cn: 拉丁语 par 意为对等，见于 pair、parity。

items.en: Latin comparare meant to pair things up or match them.
items.cn: 拉丁语 comparare 意为把东西配成对、加以匹配。

items.en: Old French comparer carried the matching sense.
items.cn: 古法语 comparer 传下了「匹配」之义。

items.en: Middle English comparen meant to match, liken and be equal.
items.cn: 中古英语 comparen 涵盖匹配、比作与相等之义。

items.en: Modern English compare grew the study phrase compare with and compare to.
items.cn: 现代英语 compare 发展出 compare with 与 compare to 的用法区别。

note.en: The first group collects the par family; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收 par 词族，第二组收近义词。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「比较」，与 compare 同根。

entries.definition: Able to be compared; as good as.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可比较的」，同根词。
形容词，义为「比较的」，同根词。
名词，义为「隔间」，拼写相近但词根不同。
动词，义为「对比」，强调差异。

entries.definition: To be equal to or pair with.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「匹配；与…相配」。

entries.definition: To say one thing is like another.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「把…比作」，较文雅。

normalIntro.en: Remember compare through its equal root and classroom habits.
normalIntro.cn: 从「对等」词根与课堂习惯记 compare。

normal.en: com- means together and par means equal.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，par 表示对等。

normal.en: pair and parity also come from par.
normal.cn: pair 与 parity 也来自 par。

normal.en: compare with looks at both; compare to praises one as the other.
normal.cn: compare with 是对比，compare to 是比作。

normal.en: compare notes means swap ideas.
normal.cn: compare notes 指交换意见。

normal.en: beyond compare means the very best.
normal.cn: beyond compare 指无与伦比。

abstract.en: Put two photos side by side on the desk.
abstract.cn: 把两张照片并排摆在桌上。

abstract.en: Hold two apples, one in each hand.
abstract.cn: 左右手各拿一个苹果。

abstract.en: See a poet pour a river into a sentence about life.
abstract.cn: 想象诗人把长河流进人生那句诗。

examples.en: Compare the prices in two shops before you buy the bag.
examples.cn: 买书包前先比较两家店的价格。

examples.en: After the quiz, we compared answers with our partners.
examples.cn: 小测后我们和同伴对了答案。

examples.en: Teachers often compare diligent students to early birds.
examples.cn: 老师常把勤奋的学生比作早起的鸟儿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扛倍儿」——两手各「扛」一样东西来比「倍儿」，compare 就是比较。

root: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ par（对等）→ comparare（配对、匹配）→ 古法语 comparer → 中古英语 comparen → 现代英语 compare；同族词有 pair（一对）、comparison（比较）、comparable（可比较的）。

sensesIntro.en: Compare runs from side-by-side looking to likening, matching and note-swapping.
sensesIntro.cn: compare 从并排细看走向比作、匹敌与互对笔记。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two things laid side by side as equals
core.cn: 核心意象：两物被当作对等者并排放置

branches.en: A poet likening life to a river

branches.cn: 没有蛋糕比得上奶奶的

intro.cn: compare 属于表示「对等」的 par 词族。

items.example: The comparison of two maps helps a lot.
items.exampleCN: 两张地图的对照很有帮助。

items.meaning: as good as; able to be compared
items.example: The two rooms are comparable in size.

items.exampleCN: 他过着相对舒适的生活。

definition_zh: 客人；宾客；旅客；特邀嘉宾
definition_en: a person who is received or entertained in another's home, hotel, or show
core_image: 一位客人推开主人家的门，主人笑着递上一杯热茶
scene: 周末外婆家来了几位远道而来的亲戚，客厅里摆满了水果和茶点。 Every guest was offered a cup of hot tea at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 guest 是「客人、宾客」（第 1 个义项：受主人接待的人）；句意是每位客人一进门就获赠一杯热茶。

pos.zh: 客人；宾客；旅客；特邀嘉宾

derivatives.zh: 由 guest + house 构成，义为「宾馆；招待所」
与 guest 相对的女主人（提示对照记忆），义为「女主人」
与 guest 同源（古英语 gast），义为「幽灵」，词形相近

senses.title: A visitor at a home
senses.definition: someone welcomed into another person's house
senses.definitionCN: 被主人欢迎进家门的人
senses.example: We invited ten guests to dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们邀请了十位客人来吃饭。
senses.why: The core picture is a door opened by a host, so the first sense is the welcomed visitor.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是主人打开的门，第一个义项就是受欢迎的来访者。

senses.title: A paying customer at a hotel
senses.definition: a person staying at a hotel or guesthouse
senses.definitionCN: 住在旅馆或招待所里的人
senses.example: The hotel has two hundred guests tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 这家旅馆今晚住着两百位客人。
senses.why: A hotel acts as a giant host, so its customers are honored as guests.
senses.whyCN: 旅馆扮演大主人，房客于是被尊称为 guest。

senses.title: An invited person on a show
senses.definition: a person invited to appear on a program or at an event
senses.definitionCN: 应邀出现在节目或活动上的人
senses.example: Tonight's guest is a famous singer.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚的嘉宾是一位著名歌手。
senses.why: The show invites you in like a house does; being invited keeps the same image.
senses.whyCN: 节目像家庭一样发出邀请，受邀感让画面保持一致。

senses.title: Anything received free for a while
senses.definition: something given a temporary place, as a guest article in a magazine
senses.definitionCN: 临时获得一席之地的事物，如杂志客座文章
senses.example: She wrote a guest post for our blog.
senses.exampleCN: 她为我们的博客写了一篇客座文章。
senses.why: Even ideas can knock on a door; temporary entries borrow the visitor image.
senses.whyCN: 连文章都能「敲门」做客，临时入驻借用访客的画面。

senses.title: One who is treated with care
senses.definition: anyone given special care and courtesy
senses.definitionCN: 受到特别款待与礼遇的人
senses.example: The team treats every customer as a guest of honor.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把每位顾客都当作贵宾对待。
senses.why: Once hosting is an attitude, anyone receiving it becomes a guest in spirit.
senses.whyCN: 当「款待」成为一种态度，任何被款待者都成了精神上的客人。

intro.en: Guest and host are an old pair; guest traveled through Old Norse into English.
intro.cn: guest 与 host 是一对古老的搭档；guest 经古诺斯语进入英语。

items.en: Proto-Germanic gastiz meant a stranger or guest, tied to ideas of hospitality.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼语 gastiz 意为陌生人、客人，与好客观念紧密相连。

items.en: Old English giest or gaest meant guest and also stranger.
items.cn: 古英语 giest / gaest 兼指客人与陌生人。

items.en: Old Norse gestr reinforced the word, giving the modern g-e-s-t shape.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 gestr 强化了该词，形成现代的 g-e-s-t 词形。

items.en: Middle English gest settled as the everyday word for a visitor.
items.cn: 中古英语 gest 固定为「来访者」的日常用词。

items.en: Modern English extended it to hotel guests, show guests, and guest writers.
items.cn: 现代英语将其扩展到旅馆房客、节目嘉宾与客座作者。

note.en: Words close to guest in form or meaning.
note.cn: 与 guest 形近或义近的词。

entries.definitionCN: 顾客，商业语境的对应者

normalIntro.en: Five memory hooks for guest.
normalIntro.cn: 五条 guest 的记忆钩子。

normal.en: guest and host are a fixed pair
normal.cn: guest（客）与 host（主）是固定搭配，对照记忆。

normal.en: guest and ghost come from the same old word gast
normal.cn: guest 与 ghost 同出古词 gast，幽灵也是「看不见的来客」。

normal.en: guest speaker is the common school phrase
normal.cn: guest speaker（特邀嘉宾）是校园常见说法。

normal.en: guess minus s sound makes guest
normal.cn: guess 与 guest 发音只差一个音，注意区分。

normal.en: hotel guest, wedding guest cover most scenes
normal.cn: hotel guest 与 wedding guest 覆盖大部分场景。

abstract.en: a door opened wide with a smile
abstract.cn: 门被笑着敞开，迎接来客。

abstract.en: a spare chair pulled to the table
abstract.cn: 餐桌旁多摆的一把椅子。

abstract.en: a name card at the show entrance
abstract.cn: 演出入口处的嘉宾名牌。

examples.en: The guests arrived just before dinner.
examples.cn: 客人们在晚饭前赶到了。

examples.en: Please sign in as a guest at the front desk.
examples.cn: 请在前台以访客身份登记。

examples.en: Every guest got a small gift at the wedding.
examples.cn: 婚礼上每位宾客都得到了一份小礼物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「给他坐」——客人进门主人招呼「给他坐」，guest 就是登门的客人。

root: 源自原始日耳曼语 gastiz（客人、陌生人），经古英语 giest 与古诺斯语 gestr 定型为 guest；同源词包括 ghost（幽灵）与拉丁语系 hostis（敌人/陌生人），核心含义是「跨进门来的那个人」。

sensesIntro.en: From a welcomed visitor the word spreads to hotel guests, invited stars, temporary posts, and honored customers.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「受欢迎的来客」扩展到旅馆住客、特邀嘉宾、客座文章与贵宾顾客。

core.cn: 核心意象：敞开的门与一杯热茶
